name: cmsi3802_compiler
description: Authors: Haley Hadiwidjojo A repository for the CMSI 3802 course at LMU. This repository will hold a custom built compiler by the author for the CMSI 3802 course.

scripts.generate-ds: node --input-type=module -e "import generateDS, {convertMonsterToAST} from './src/ds-generator.js'; import fs from 'fs'; const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8')); let ast; if (Array.isArray(data) && data[0] && data[0].name) { ast = {kind: 'Program', declarations: data.map(convertMonsterToAST)}; } else { ast = data; } console.log(generateDS(ast));"

author: Haley Hadiwidjojo
